profile.visual_desc: Human rider in blue armor and flowing blue cape, mounted on a massive dark blue dragon with spiny head and large leathery wings.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Determined male with sharp eyes and spiky blue hair tied by a gray headband, shown in a confident left-facing profile.
profile.weapon_desc: Long golden polearm held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left; dragon stationary with wings flared, rider seated firmly with cape draped.
profile.step2_windup: Dragon rears back while wings expand; rider pulls the polearm back to the right to build momentum.
profile.step3_impact: Sudden downward swing creating a large, crescent-shaped golden energy arc sweeping from high-right to low-left.
profile.step4_finish: Rider follows through as the golden arc fades; dragon stabilizes and returns to a neutral flight stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 aligns with the downward diagonal trajectory of the polearm's swing.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence correctly expands DOS reference. Wind-up and VFX alignment are consistent with source material. Perspective remains stable.
